prompt:
## Why Set It Up?

The officials knew that the Gir booth would serve only one voter. They still followed the same rules as at any city booth: the same secrecy and the same ink mark on the finger.

**Predict:** Why does a democracy set up a booth for one voter?

options.text: It was a mistake in the list: his name should have gone to another booth.
It was mainly for show, to let people see how careful the officials are.
Every vote counts the same, so living far away must not stop anyone voting.
